1. Review memory/WORKING.md - is it current?

Keeps the system lean and compounds learning.

name: Drift Audit (Core Architecture)

payload.text:
🔍 Drift Audit — CORE ARCHITECTURE SPEC

Run: scripts/deploy/drift-audit.sh

Checks:
1. Canonical files integrity (canon/ directory)
2. Generated configs match canonical source (config/)
3. No forbidden changes (Kommo refs, unauthorized agents)
4. Directory structure correct
5. All cron jobs match manifest
6. No drift detected

Output: observability/drift-audit/audit-result-YYYYMMDD.json

Allowed auto-fixes (safe):
- Regenerate config/ from canon/
- Create missing directories
- Increment patch version

Manual flags (require review):
- Canon file content changes
- Breaking cron job changes
- New credentials
- Active code modifications

Alert Steve if flags found.

description: Daily drift audit, safe auto-fixes, manual flags for risky changes

name: personal_inbox_maintenance

payload.message:
📧 PERSONAL GMAIL INBOX MAINTENANCE (v2.0)

Target: vettoristeve@gmail.com

Every run:
1. Scan inbox
2. Auto-archive using ENHANCED rules (v2.0):
   - Precedence: bulk | list | junk
   - Auto-Submitted: auto-generated | auto-replied
   - X-Auto-Response-Suppress: All | OOF
   - List-Id: [any value]
   - List-Unsubscribe: [header present]
   - Gmail promotional label
   - Sender: newsletter/updates/no-reply/marketing
3. SMART ARCHIVING: Check contact status FIRST
   - If sender in contacts/VIP/previous correspondent → Don't archive, classify as FYI instead
   - If sender NOT known → Archive
4. Categorize remaining: urgent, action-required, waiting, informational
5. Flag urgent and action-required emails
6. Count archived emails

At briefing times (8 AM, 1 PM, 6 PM EST only):
Send to Clawson:

📋 PERSONAL INBOX BRIEFING

Urgent:
<list items>

Needs Reply:
<list items>

FYI:
<list items>

Archived Automatically:
<count>

Safety rules (UNCHANGED):
- NEVER auto-reply
- NEVER delete emails
- NEVER unsubscribe
- Only archive low-priority bulk/marketing
- Known contacts never archived (even if bulk headers)

Rules reference: canon/agents/personal-assistant/email-cleanup-rules.md

description: Personal Gmail inbox maintenance (v2.0): enhanced bulk detection (headers), smart contact checking, send briefings to Clawson at 8 AM, 1 PM, 6 PM
